section: 28. Company Boss: Wrapping Up the Investigation
description: Investigate the company boss, track down the "whereabouts of the statue", clues from all sides converge, the outline of the mastermind gradually becomes clear

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Sir, wish us luck, for that also means wishing you luck."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "That's right."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Toscanini snorted impatiently and waved his hand: Get out of here! If you find that damn statue, let me know.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Young man, what's the procedure for handling this statue? Don't be nervous, take your time."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Did you just throw the statue somewhere or what?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Don't be nervous. Recalling it now is a bit late, but there's still room for remedy."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Simply observing the expression of the person in front of me, I suspect if he secretly made a deal with someone else and sold the statue.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you wish for, it will be answered. <player5>'s Psychology Wish:

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Marco wiped the sweat from his forehead, calming down a bit: According to theater procedure, old props are first registered... He pulled out a yellowed list from a dirty folder. Look, this model is recorded here, bought last month on the 25th by the Venetian antique dealer Mr. Brandoli.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Wiping sweat "His private museum is in? Venice?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Good news, at least we roughly know where it was lost."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "If it's really in Venice, sir, you should continue training your people."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Marco nodded repeatedly: Yes, in the alley behind St. Mark's Square in Venice, the sign says 'Brandoli Classical Art'. He took out a handkerchief to wipe his sweat.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #After listening, I give him a gesture wishing him good luck.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: (I think it's on the singer ( )

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Saying to the others "I say, everyone, now the fragment has gone to Venice. We have 37 hours left. I think it's pretty hopeless to get it back in time."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: (Is there any obvious difference compared to now? )

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Bailan carefully observed Marco's expression—the sweat on his forehead, his trembling fingers, and his confused look when mentioning the statue all indicated that he was indeed just following procedure, without any guilt or signs of hiding something.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "We have tickets."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Yes, that's right."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Do you remember the Maestro's, condition at the time?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Sharing my guess with everyone, fearing something bad might happen at the concert.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Marco scratched his head: The Maestro was just as irritable the day he signed as he is now... He imitated Toscanini's action, waving an imaginary baton, 'Get rid of these damn antiques! Aida needs a modern stage!'—that's exactly how he yelled.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Ahem... let's talk about that later."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Prayer received! Continuing to record the horror of the Orient Express for you. Currently, 7787 texts have been recorded, taking 38 hours, 49 minutes, and 26 seconds.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Night fell, and the investigators turned into a dim alley. The damp air was filled with the smell of rotting fruit and urine, with moldy cardboard boxes piled in the corners.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #After approaching this corpse, first simply observe if there are any wounds on the body.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Bailan discovered two small puncture wounds on both sides of his neck, with the surrounding skin shriveled into strange radial patterns.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Wow, could this be... the legendary vampire?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Kneeling down to carefully examine the cause of death, etc.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you expect, it will be answered. <player4>'s Medical Prayer:

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: @player8 He wears an employee badge from La Scala Opera House on his chest.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Check if there's a name on the employee badge! "It seems someone has been paying attention to us."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Explain the analyzed symptoms to everyone.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Half of a La Scala Opera House work ID is visible from the corpse's sleeve. The man in the ID photo is smiling, forming a terrifying contrast with the grimacing expression of the mummy before them. Name: Luigi Moretti Position: Stage Props Manager La Scala Opera House Management Department.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Died from having his blood drained."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "So it really is a vampire!?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Ridiculous."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "By the way, this is completely a sign that someone knows we're here too."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: So scary.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Someone has been following us all along."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Though it's scary, the skinning action is still deft.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player4 obtains Human Skin*3.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Following might be an overstatement."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Check the time.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Right." #Nod in agreement.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "If player4 can track the statue fragments using the human skin."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "That kind of delusional condition, there's no reason others couldn't track us."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Should we head back first? It's getting late."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "The question is, in what way did he track us."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Maybe he's not tracking us."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Or maybe he or It also knows this spell, tracking the statue in my hands."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Snaps fingers.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "So, should we head back first?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #player2 expresses agreement.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "There aren't any other clues either, let's go back. Remember to inform that props master about the employee's death next time we meet."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Sneak back to the hotel to sleep.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Bail, retreat, sell, flee.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Go back and rest.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The investigators wearily return to the hotel. The night of Milan envelops the streets, with the occasional hum of a passing tram in the distance. The gas lamps in the hotel corridor flicker, and water stain traces from last night's ritual still remain on the carpet.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #After the day's exhaustion, Johnson takes a shower and returns to his room to rest.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The investigators wake up in excruciating pain—their abdomens and backs are covered with dark red grid-like rashes, as if branded with an invisible iron into a chessboard-like pattern of scars.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Decide to go see the most reliable doctor in our team.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Muggle asks player4 about the skin condition.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: When they gather painfully on the balcony, an even more horrifying sight appears—the Egyptian mural above the corridor has been altered without anyone noticing: the originally elegant Egyptian woman now has a ferocious, screaming face. Opposite her, a man has a cat-monkey-like creature perched on his shoulder, its claws deeply embedded in the man's collarbone, yet the man wears an ecstatic smile.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Rub my eyes to see if I'm seeing things wrong.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Lift my shirt to carefully examine this rash.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The pattern has indeed changed.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: .ra Medicine

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you wish for, it will surely receive a response. <player4>'s Medicine prayer:

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: .ra Occult

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you wish for, it will surely receive a response. <player4>'s Occult prayer:

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player4 lifts his shirt and carefully examines the grid-like rash on his abdomen. Those dark red lines intersect into perfect checkerboard squares, each square's edges slightly raised, with a burning sensation when touched. As a medical student, he has never seen similar symptoms in textbooks or clinical cases—it neither resembles contact dermatitis nor matches any known allergic reaction pattern.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "This is definitely not dermatitis."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Too neat, perhaps?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Doesn't match any dermatological symptoms."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Scratch my belly. "Then it must be cursed."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Pathologically, it doesn't make sense."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Seems we need to find the mastermind sooner.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I think it's related to that statue."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "So I guess we need to hurry and find, um... the torso part of the statue?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Yes."

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Ouch, it hurts..." #Lift the back of my shirt. "Then let me lend a hand."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: .st san -1d4

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #player4 reads the newspaper during the ritual.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player4>'s "Sanity" change: 65 ➯ 61 (deduct -1d4=-4)

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: .ra Occult

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you wish for, it will surely receive a response. <player4>'s Occult prayer:

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player4 endures severe headache and dizziness, casting the tracking spell once more. As the incantation is chanted, he feels a piercing chill running up his spine to the back of his head—his vision suddenly distorts, and overlapping whispers of laughter echo in his ears, as if countless mouths are breathing right against his earlobes.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I saw it! I saw it!"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #tissue stuffed in nostrils

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #administer first aid to myself

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Milan Morning Post January 16th

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #player2 let's go

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #pack up and head to the theater

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: When the investigators arrived at Piazza della Scala, the scene before them forced them to stop—all entrances to the opera house were tightly guarded by Blackshirts, wearing crisp black uniforms, their silver collar pins gleaming coldly in the sunlight. At the main entrance, two armed guards were checking the credentials of each staff member one by one, not even sparing prop boxes, roughly lifting each lid to inspect.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #retreat!

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #sneak away

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #run

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: (@player3 do you have a map of Milan? (

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #saw that person's gaze, quickly stroll away to a distance
